text:
meera: quick heads-up — we're seeing intermittent proto deserialization errors from SDK v1.7.2 talking to runtime 2.16.1, but only in ap-southeast-1 canary traffic. stack traces point to a header compression mismatch.
andre: ack. is this crashing hosts or just request failures (4xx/5xx)?
jess: mostly 5xx at the routing layer; qps not huge (~30 rps on canary).
meera: right — fails are ~0.8% of requests last 20m, spike after the regional egress change. other regions are clean.
sam: can we short-circuit by pinning SDK to v1.7.1 for that region while infra team investigates? we should keep the rest of canary untouched.
andre: +1 for regional soft-pin. need clear rollback criteria and a short change window. propose pin for 6 hours then reassess.
jess: agree. telemetry check: if 5xx > 0.5% for 10m after pin -> rollback routing change. also add alert to #eng-sre.
meera: i'll add a release-note bullet and notify customer success for impacted tenants. also will attach the sample stacktrace in the ticket.
sam: deploybot, please apply regional SDK pin: region=ap-southeast-1 sdk=1.7.1 window=6h reason="ap-southeast-1 proto deserialization"
deploybot: Executing: /deploy pin --scope region=ap-southeast-1 --component sdk --version 1.7.1 --duration 6h --comment "ap-southeast-1 proto deserialization"
deploybot: Pin applied to ap-southeast-1 SDK version 1.7.1. Change id: PIN-20260322-44. UI: https://console.redwood.ai/changes/PIN-20260322-44
andre: nice. will monitor error budget and KV cache LRU pressure in that region.
jess: i'll add a small smoke job to hit the common codepaths every 30s. posting logs to the ticket.
meera: ops playbook note — if we see regressions or customer impact > 2 tenants, we escalate to platform oncall and open rollback.
sam: timeline: investigate for 6h, aim to unpin if infra patch merges and e2e smoke passes. otherwise extend and schedule a targeted hotfix release.
andre: one more: add an automated rollback hook: if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m after pin -> rollback the routing change (not the pin) and notify #incidents.
meera: done — added hooks and release-note entry. tagging @jess for follow-up.
jess: got it, running smoke now.
deploybot: Update: telemetry alert created (ALERT-3222-PIN). Will post runbook link in the change.
meera: thanks. I'll post a short note in the weekly release notes draft under "hotfixes & regional mitigations".
sam: LGTM. we should sync post-mortem if this persists beyond the window. :thumbsup:
meera: closing loop here — keep thread updated, will unpin if all green by 3222226933.
